name: Custom output bit pattern / anti-theft pulse type
explain: Low byte holds rcv_Arg2 plus (bits1-2) the anti-theft pulse type (0=off,1-3=pulse styles); high byte is a 7-bit custom on/off pattern entered as a string of 1s/0s in the UI, used to drive an output (labelled 'Morse Code' in the app) (effect unverified).
notes: 自定义输出模式 / 防盗脉冲:0-无效,1-防盗脉冲1类型,2-防盗脉冲2类型,3-防盗脉冲3类型

name: Speed loop KP/KI gain pair
explain: Low byte is the proportional gain (SpeedKP) and high byte the integral gain (SpeedKI) of the closed-loop speed regulator; tunes how aggressively motor RPM tracks the commanded speed (effect unverified).
notes: SpeedKP/SpeedKI | SpeedKP / SpeedKI: label: SpeedKP / SpeedKI (no localized string in .cs)

name: Throttle low/high voltage threshold
explain: Low byte is the throttle signal voltage treated as zero throttle (0-2V), high byte the voltage treated as full throttle (2.5-5V); values outside the configured window are clamped.
notes: ThrottleLow/ThrottleHigh | ThrottleLow=油门低阈值(ProControlPage.cs:2156), ThrottleHigh=油门高阈值(ProControlPage.cs:2157)

name: Traction control enable / startup field-weakening word (FAIF)
explain: Bit 5 of the high byte enables Traction Control (TCS) per TCS_Clicked, toggled together with addr190/addr200; the same 16-bit word is also written wholesale by the Pro-mode FAIF field, whose exact effect is unclear (effect unverified).
notes: TCS开启/关闭; FAIF

name: Acceleration/deceleration curve response time
explain: Time constant for the throttle/torque ramp curve; larger values make acceleration and deceleration smoother (effect unverified — exact scale approximate, see CurveTime_TextChanged's num=val/2-1 transform).
notes: CurveTime | CurveTime=曲线采样(ProControlPage.cs:2117)

name: Direction, brake response, park, NTC/PTC, anti-theft, phase-exchange config bits
explain: Packed configuration word written by many separate UI controls, each preserving the other bits: bit7=motor rotation direction, bits5-6=park mode (0=reverse-park,1=switch-park,2=disabled,3=slow-descent park), bits0-4=brake response mode, high-byte bits4-7(low nibble of low byte per NTC_PTC)=temperature sensor type, high-byte bit3=PC13/response mode, high-byte bit4=current anti-theft enable, low-byte bit7=phase exchange, high-byte bits0-2=slow-descent (steep hill) level (effect unverified).
notes: 方向/驻坡/刹车/NTC_PTC/PC13/电流防盗/交换相线/陡坡缓降 combined register

name: Motor phase/encoder angle offset
explain: Electrical angle offset applied between the encoder/Hall reading and the motor's true rotor position, used to correct phase alignment (effect unverified; no min/max clamp observed in the UI).
notes: PhaseOffset | PhaseOffset=相移(ProControlPage.cs:2084)

name: Zero-position ADC calibration coefficient
explain: Raw ADC count corresponding to the throttle's zero (closed) position, used to calibrate the analog throttle input; the decompiled field is labelled 'ZeroBattCoeff' but the 768-1024 range matches a throttle zero-point calibration, not a battery value (effect unverified).
notes: ZeroBattCoeff (label likely a misnomer for throttle ADC zero point) | ZeroBattCoeff=0电量系数(ProControlPage.cs:2119)

name: Full-position ADC calibration coefficient
explain: Raw ADC count corresponding to the throttle's full (wide-open) position, used to calibrate the analog throttle input; labelled 'FullBattCoeff' in the decompiled source but paired with addr13's zero point, so likely a throttle calibration value despite the name (effect unverified).
notes: FullBattCoeff (label likely a misnomer for throttle ADC full-scale point) | FullBattCoeff=满电量系数(ProControlPage.cs:2120)

name: Mid-speed current-loop KI/KP gain pair
explain: Low byte (MidKI) and high byte (labelled StartKI in one handler) tune the current-loop controller used around mid motor speed; the decompiled UI/variable names are inconsistent about which half is which (effect unverified).
notes: MidKI/StartKI | label: MidKI / StartKI (no localized string in .cs)

name: Max-speed / startup current-loop KI/KC gain pair
explain: Low byte (MaxKI, range 1-24) and high byte (StartKC, range 1-16) tune the current-loop controller; the decompiled UI/variable names are inconsistent about which is which (effect unverified).
notes: MaxKI/StartKC | label: MaxKI / StartKC (no localized string in .cs)

name: Mid/Max KC current-loop gain pair
explain: Two related current-loop gain coefficients (MaxKC low byte, MidKC high byte per one handler, swapped in the other) packed into one register; precise effect on the control loop unverified.
notes: MaxKC/MidKC | label: MaxKC / MidKC (no localized string in .cs)

name: D-axis inductance (LD)
explain: Motor's d-axis winding inductance parameter used by the FOC current controller; units are not confirmed from the decompiled UI (effect unverified).
notes: LD | label: LD (no localized string in .cs)

name: Fault alarm delay
explain: Delay before the controller reports a detected fault condition, used to filter transient glitches (effect unverified).
notes: AlarmDelay | AlarmDelay=告警延时(ProControlPage.cs:1755)

name: Motor pole pairs
explain: Number of magnetic pole pairs in the motor; used to convert between electrical and mechanical RPM.
notes: PolePairs | PolePairs=极对数(PolePairsDisplay label, ProControlPage.cs:1561)

name: Maximum motor speed (high gear)
explain: Electrical RPM ceiling the controller enforces in high gear / full-speed mode.
notes: MaxSpeed / DHSpeed | DHSpeed=高速档速度(ParaPage.cs:6523 label), MaxSpeed=最大转速(ProControlPage.cs:1682)

name: Motor rated power
explain: Nameplate rated power of the motor, used by the controller for power-limiting calculations.
notes: RatedPower | RatedPower=额定功率(ProControlPage.cs:1563 label / 3563)

name: Battery rated voltage
explain: Nominal pack voltage class (e.g. 48V/60V/72V) the controller is configured for; affects protection thresholds and internal scaling.
notes: RatedVoltage / 额定电压

name: Motor rated speed
explain: Nameplate rated rotational speed of the motor, used as a reference point for the power/torque curves.
notes: RatedSpeed | RatedSpeed=额定转速(ProControlPage.cs:1681)

name: Maximum battery (line) current
explain: Peak current the controller draws from the battery side, independent of motor phase current; protects the pack and wiring.
notes: MaxLineCurr | DH=高速档力度(ParaPage.cs:6283 label), MaxLineCurr=最大线电流(ProControlPage.cs:2137)

name: Weak-field strength, speed-pulse count, follow/ECO/gear mode config
explain: Packed word: low-byte bits4-5=field-weakening strength (fast/middle/slow), low-byte bits0-1=follow-throttle mode, low-byte bits2-3=ECO throttle response curve (linear/sport/eco), high-byte bits0-4=speed-sensor pulse count (1-31), high-byte bits5-7=gear default mode; several separate UI controls all write this one register (effect unverified).
notes: 弱磁特性/速度脉冲/跟随/油门响应/档位方式

name: Q-axis inductance (LQ)
explain: Motor's q-axis winding inductance parameter used by the FOC current controller; units are not confirmed (effect unverified).
notes: LQ | label: LQ (no localized string in .cs)

name: Battery rated capacity
explain: Nameplate amp-hour capacity of the battery pack, used for state-of-charge estimation.
notes: BattRatedCap1 | BattRatedCap1=电池容量(ProControlPage.cs:2143)

name: Motor phase internal resistance
explain: Stator winding resistance value used by the controller's motor model / FOC estimator; units are not confirmed (effect unverified).
notes: IntRes | IntRes=电池内阻(ProControlPage.cs:1699 label -- Chinese label calls it 'battery' resistance despite being read alongside motor params)

name: Forward/reverse power ratio
explain: Percentage limit applied to output power/torque when the motor runs in reverse, relative to forward (effect unverified).
notes: FwReRatio | FwReRatio=后退齿比(ProControlPage.cs:1756)

name: Low battery voltage protection threshold
explain: Pack voltage below which the controller cuts or limits power to protect the battery from over-discharge.
notes: LowVolProtect | LowVolProtect=欠压保护(ProControlPage.cs:3609)

name: Output relay / drive-mode feature enable bitfield
explain: 16-bit register where bits 0-10, 14 and 15 each toggle one single-bit output-relay or drive-mode feature (cruise, EABS, seat switch, auto-park, anti-theft, etc.) -- nearly every checkbox on the Para/Pro config pages targets one bit of this same word. ProControlPage.cs's RelayDelay_TextChanged is the one exception: instead of read-modify-writing a single bit like the other 21 handlers, it overwrites the *entire* 16-bit register (bits 0-15) with a raw numeric delay value, so this register also doubles as a plain relay-delay-time value in whatever mode that handler is used from; bit 15 (above) is a separate single-bit flag that is presumed to select the units (ms vs 1s) that value is interpreted in, but the two were not reconciled further (effect unverified).
notes: 位0=坐桶/刹车灯(BC), 位1=坐桶开关(Seat), 位2=P档继电器(PGear), 位3=自动驻坡(AutoBackP), 位4=巡航(XH/Cruise), 位5=电子刹车(EABS), 位6=推行(Tuixing/freewheel), 位7=强制防盗, 位8=超速报警, 位9=驻坡禁刹车, 位10=记忆档位, 位14=后退使能, 位15=继电器延时单位(ms/1s选择, 单个bit). RelayDelay_TextChanged (bits 0-15, a raw delay value overwriting the whole register) is a separate, non-bitfield use of this same address -- 继电器延时(raw value, not a bit).

name: Save-config timestamp (write-only command)
explain: 6-byte year/month/day/hour/minute/second value written just before the save command (addr160 sub-command 4); records when parameters were last saved rather than a tunable setting.
notes: 保存时间戳

name: Custom maximum line current (secondary limit)
explain: A second, user-adjustable line-current ceiling distinct from the primary MaxLineCurr register, likely a customer-configurable cap below the hardware max (effect unverified).
notes: CustomMaxLineCurr | CustomMaxLineCurr=Boost线电流(ProControlPage.cs:2139)

name: Custom maximum phase current (secondary limit)
explain: A second, user-adjustable phase-current ceiling distinct from the primary MaxPhaseCurr register (effect unverified).
notes: CustomMaxPhaseCurr | CustomMaxPhaseCurr=Boost相电流(ProControlPage.cs:2140)

name: Low-gear speed limit
explain: Electrical RPM ceiling enforced when the vehicle is in low gear.
notes: LowSpeed | DL=低速档速度(ParaPage.cs:6683 label), LowSpeed=低速转速(ProControlPage.cs:1691)

name: Reverse-gear speed limit
explain: Electrical RPM ceiling enforced when the vehicle is driving in reverse.
notes: BackSpeed | BackSpeed=后退转速(ProControlPage.cs:1711)

name: Mid-gear speed limit
explain: Electrical RPM ceiling enforced when the vehicle is in middle gear.
notes: MidSpeed | DM=中速档速度(ParaPage.cs:6603 label), MidSpeed=中速转速(ProControlPage.cs:1703)

name: Maximum deceleration rate
explain: Steepest allowed deceleration ramp the controller applies, e.g. releasing the throttle or braking; units/scale not confirmed (effect unverified).
notes: Max_Dec | Max_Dec=减速灵敏度(ProControlPage.cs:2145)

name: Free/neutral throttle deadband
explain: Deadband applied around the throttle's released position to prevent creeping from a non-zero idle signal (effect unverified).
notes: FreeThrottle | FreeThrottle=电刹油门(ProControlPage.cs:2118)

name: Maximum motor phase current
explain: Peak current the controller drives through the motor windings; the primary torque/power limiting parameter.
notes: MaxPhaseCurr | DH=高速档力度(ParaPage.cs:6283 label), MaxPhaseCurr=最大相电流(ProControlPage.cs:2138)

name: Analog speedometer / speed-sensor scale value
explain: Reference RPM value used to scale the analog speedometer output or an analog speed-limit input, depending on mode (effect unverified).
notes: SpeedAnalog | SpeedAnalog=模拟速度表系数(ProControlPage.cs:2150)

name: Maximum acceleration rate
explain: Steepest allowed acceleration ramp when the throttle is applied; units/scale not confirmed (effect unverified).
notes: Max_Acc | Max_Acc=加速灵敏度(ProControlPage.cs:2144)

name: Regen / stop-back current base level (energy feedback strength)
explain: Base coefficient for the selected regenerative-braking strength preset (Energy Feedback selector); also directly editable as StopBackCurr, described elsewhere as an anti-rollback current value (effect unverified).
notes: 能量回馈强度 / StopBackCurr

name: Regen / stop-back current secondary level
explain: Second coefficient accompanying addr48 for the selected regenerative-braking strength preset; also user-editable directly as MaxBackCurr (effect unverified).
notes: MaxBackCurr | EnergyBack=能量回馈强度(ParaPage.cs:6183 label), MaxBackCurr=最大回馈电流(ProControlPage.cs:2142)

name: Low/mid-gear line current percentage pair
explain: Line-current limit for low gear (low byte) and mid gear (high byte), each entered as a percentage and scaled by 128/100 before storage.
notes: LowSpeedLineCurr/MidSpeedLineCurr | DM=中速档力度(ParaPage.cs:6363 label), DL=低速档力度(ParaPage.cs:6443 label), LowSpeedLineCurr=低速线电流/MidSpeedLineCurr=中速线电流(ProControlPage.cs:2080-2081)

name: Low/mid-gear phase current percentage pair
explain: Phase-current limit for low gear (low byte) and mid gear (high byte), each entered as a percentage and scaled by 128/100 before storage.
notes: LowSpeedPhaseCurr/MidSpeedPhaseCurr | DM=中速档力度(ParaPage.cs:6363 label), DL=低速档力度(ParaPage.cs:6443 label), LowSpeedPhaseCurr=低速相电流/MidSpeedPhaseCurr=中速相电流(ProControlPage.cs:2082-2083)

name: Motor stall/blocked-rotor detection time
explain: Time the controller waits with no rotation detected before declaring a stall/blocked-rotor fault (effect unverified).
notes: BlockTime | BlockTime=堵转时间(ProControlPage.cs:1735)

name: Speedometer pulse output divider/count
explain: Number of pulses per revolution (or similar divider) the controller outputs to drive an external pulse speedometer (effect unverified).
notes: SpdPulseNum | SpdPulseNum=速度脉冲基数(ProControlPage.cs:1736)

name: Secondary motor temperature sensor coefficient
explain: Calibration coefficient for a second motor-temperature sense channel, used by the FOC over-temperature protection (effect unverified).
notes: TempCoeff2 | TempCoeff2=温度系数(ProControlPage.cs:3675)

name: Boost/Cruise/Side-stand/Park-pause input pin assignment
explain: Four 4-bit nibbles pick which physical controller pin (or none) is wired to the Boost, Cruise (XH), Side-stand (BC) and Pause/Park (P) input functions.
notes: Boost/巡航/边撑/P档 Pin

name: Forward/Reverse/High-speed/Low-speed input pin assignment
explain: Four 4-bit nibbles pick which physical controller pin drives the Forward (FW), Reverse (RE), High-speed (SDH) and Low-speed (SDL) gear-select inputs.
notes: 前进/后退/高速/低速 Pin

name: Charge/Anti-theft/Seat/Voltage-select input pin assignment
explain: Four 4-bit nibbles pick which physical controller pin drives the Charge (CHG), Anti-theft (FD), Seat-switch and Voltage-select inputs.
notes: 充电/防盗/坐桶/选择电压 Pin

name: Pro-mode speed limit (LmtSpeed)
explain: An additional configurable RPM ceiling exposed only on the Pro control page, separate from the per-gear speed limits (effect unverified).
notes: LmtSpeed | LmtSpeed=限速转速(ProControlPage.cs:1692)

name: Weak-field response, MOE, zero-speed-switch, quick-release and speedometer-mode config word
explain: Packed word combining several Pro-mode toggles: MOE enable, 0-speed switch valid/invalid, a 3-bit weak-field response time, a 3-bit quick-throttle-release response, speedometer output mode (pulse/analog/isolated), and a deep-weak-field special mode bit; each toggle preserves the other bits via cached rconfig_word0/1 values (effect unverified).
notes: MOE/0速切换/弱磁响应/回油门/快速后退/速度表方式/深度弱磁

name: Motor over-temperature protect/restore thresholds
explain: Temperature at which the controller begins limiting power (low byte, 100-180C) and the temperature it must cool back below before restoring full power (high byte, 80-160C).
notes: MotorTempProtect/MotorTempRestore | MotorTempProtect=电机温度保护(ProControlPage.cs:3753), MotorTempRestore=电机温度恢复(ProControlPage.cs:3754)

name: CAN bus node/address configuration
explain: CAN bus node id or address byte used when the controller communicates over CAN (effect unverified).
notes: CANConfig | CANConfig=CAN通信(ProControlPage.cs:1564/3747)

explain: Packed word: low-byte bits6-7 = idle/empty-speed level (0-3), low-byte bits0-4 = an analog gain setting (AN, 0-31), high-byte bits0-6 = an output limit setting (LM, 5-83), high-byte bit5 = relay output polarity/invert (RelayOut) (effect unverified).

explain: Current threshold for the first stage of a two-stage battery discharge-limiting scheme (effect unverified).
notes: Stage1Curr | Stage1Curr=龟速限流系数(ProControlPage.cs:1725)

name: Battery voltage-class auto-select ratio
explain: Ratio used to automatically detect/select the connected battery's voltage class from a measured voltage (effect unverified).
notes: VolSelectRatio | VolSelectRatio=电压选择系数(ProControlPage.cs:1726)

name: System command (save/reset/restore-preset)
explain: Write-only command register: byte4 (low byte) is always 0x88 (136), byte5 (high byte) selects the action — 4=save current parameters, 5 or 15=reset controller (varies by firmware version), 8=restore factory defaults, 9-14=apply named presets (PIN10/PIN11 key function, auto-learn, back-throttle EABS, non-EABS/freewheel, XM).
notes: 恢复方式/复位/保存: byte4固定0x88, byte5为子命令

name: One-wire comm protocol timing/section values 0-1
explain: Two adjacent bytes of an 8-entry 'section' timing table (SEC0-SEC7) used to configure the single-wire (one-wire) dashboard communication protocol; exact units/meaning unconfirmed (effect unverified).
notes: SEC0/SEC1 | label: SEC0 / SEC1 (no localized string in .cs)

name: One-wire comm protocol timing/section values 2-3
explain: Two adjacent bytes of the SEC0-SEC7 one-wire dashboard protocol timing table (effect unverified).
notes: SEC2/SEC3 | label: SEC2 / SEC3 (no localized string in .cs)

name: One-wire comm protocol timing/section values 4-5
explain: Two adjacent bytes of the SEC0-SEC7 one-wire dashboard protocol timing table (effect unverified).
notes: SEC4/SEC5 | label: SEC4 / SEC5 (no localized string in .cs)

name: One-wire comm protocol timing/section values 6-7
explain: Two adjacent bytes of the SEC0-SEC7 one-wire dashboard protocol timing table (effect unverified).
notes: SEC6/SEC7 | label: SEC6 / SEC7 (no localized string in .cs)

name: One-wire comm gear/output position nibbles (P/BC/Handlebar/FD)
explain: Four 4-bit nibbles (0-15) encoding the reported dashboard position/index for P-gear, side-stand (BC), handlebar and anti-theft (FD) states over the one-wire dashboard protocol (effect unverified).
notes: Ppos/BCPos/HBarPos/FDPos | Ppos=P位置/BCPos=边撑位置/HBarPos=转把位置/FDPos=防盗位置(ProControlPage.cs:1718-1721)

name: One-wire comm pulse count / square-wave high time
explain: Low byte = pulse count/divider (Pulse), high byte = square-wave high time (SQH) for the one-wire dashboard signal (effect unverified).
notes: Pulse/SQH | label: Pulse / SQH (no localized string in .cs)

name: One-wire comm line-current display coefficient
explain: Scaling coefficient applied to the line-current value reported over the one-wire dashboard protocol (effect unverified).
notes: OneLineCurrCoeff | OneLineCurrCoeff=电流系数(ProControlPage.cs:1722)

name: CAN bus speed, back-to-park delay and seat delay config
explain: Packed word: bits0-2 select CAN bus baud rate (250k/500k/1M), bits0-4 select a back-to-park delay time from a preset table (3s up to 300s or unlimited), bits5-7 select a seat-switch delay (1-7 units).
notes: CAN速度/回P档延时/SeatDelay

name: Two-stage discharge: stage-2 SOC threshold
explain: State-of-charge threshold for the second stage of a two-stage battery discharge-limiting scheme; paired with Stage1Curr/addr158 (effect unverified).
notes: Stage2Soc | Stage2Soc=弱磁电流系数(ProControlPage.cs:1727 -- Chinese label describes it as a weak-field current coefficient, not obviously an SOC threshold; flagged as a possible label/behavior mismatch)

name: Under-voltage protection mode, current-limit way, TCS mode and ECO-acceleration level
explain: Packed word: low byte (0-12) selects the low-voltage protection style (fixed voltage drop, SOC percentage, or SOP value); high-byte low nibble is a current-limit-way selector (CurrLimitWay); high-byte high nibble selects the Traction Control (TCS) road-surface mode or the ECO acceleration level (1-8), depending on which UI control last wrote it.
notes: 欠压方式/TCS/经济加速/CurrLimitWay

name: Boost (overload) duration timer
explain: How long the controller allows a temporary current/power boost above the normal limit before reverting (effect unverified).
notes: BstTime | BstTime=Boost时间(ProControlPage.cs:1729)

name: Boost release/cooldown timer
explain: Cooldown period required after a boost event before another boost can be triggered (effect unverified).
notes: BstRelease | BstRelease=Boost释放(ProControlPage.cs:1730)

name: Park-mode engage timer
explain: Time the vehicle must be stationary before the park/anti-rollback function engages (effect unverified).
notes: ParkTime | ParkTime=驻车时间(ProControlPage.cs:1731)

name: Inverse-time (I2t style) overload protection timer
explain: Time constant for an inverse-time overload curve, where higher overcurrent trips faster (effect unverified).
notes: InverseTime | InverseTime=反向时间(ProControlPage.cs:1732)

name: Torque calculation coefficient
explain: Scaling coefficient the controller uses to convert current/FOC quantities into a torque command or display value (effect unverified).
notes: TorqueCoeff | TorqueCoeff=扭矩系数(ProControlPage.cs:1728)

name: Throttle auto-learn: low (released) ADC value
explain: Raw ADC value captured during throttle auto-learn for the released position (effect unverified).
notes: LearnVol | LearnVol=自学习电压低(ProControlPage.cs:1738)

name: Throttle auto-learn: high (full) ADC value
explain: Raw ADC value captured during throttle auto-learn for the fully-open position (effect unverified).
notes: LearnVoh | LearnVoh=自学习电压高(ProControlPage.cs:1739)

name: Park-mode speed-differential threshold
explain: Speed difference threshold used to decide when the park/anti-rollback control should intervene (effect unverified).
notes: ParkDiff | ParkDiff=缓降转速(ProControlPage.cs:1733)

name: Sensorless/Isin startup angle parameter
explain: Startup parameter related to initial rotor-angle estimation (Isin) used before the motor is spinning fast enough for normal FOC (effect unverified).
notes: IsinStart | IsinStart=启动Is(ProControlPage.cs:1737)

name: Throttle-follow insert / TCS threshold configuration word
explain: Configuration word for the throttle-follow feature; bit5 is toggled together with addr9 when the TCS mode is changed, full field layout otherwise unconfirmed (effect unverified).
notes: ThrottleInsert | ThrottleInsert=油门插拔(ProControlPage.cs:1761)

name: Throttle-follow exit speed and regen current ratio
explain: Low byte = speed at which throttle-follow/cruise disengages (FollowSpeed), high byte = a regen current ratio applied on release (ReCurrRatio, 32-255).
notes: FollowSpeed/ReCurrRatio | FollowSpeed=跟随转速(ProControlPage.cs:1762), ReCurrRatio=后退电流比(ProControlPage.cs:1763)

name: Angle-learn state, speed-limit-pin and repair-pin selection
explain: Low byte = angle-learn status/result byte; high byte packs the speed-limit input pin selection (low nibble) and one-key-repair input pin selection (high nibble).
notes: anglelearn/限速Pin/一键修复Pin

name: High/low-speed switch mode, temp-70 level, long-back, no-CAN timeout, throttle-lost alarm
explain: Low byte = no-CAN-signal timeout (in 10s units); high byte bits0-3 = high/low speed switch mode (SPModeConfig, 0-15), bits4-5 = a 'Temp70' threshold level, bit6 = long-press-for-reverse enable, bit7 = throttle-lost alarm enable.
notes: 高低速/温度70/长按后退/无CAN超时/油门丢失告警

name: Throttle auto-learn trigger and low-capacity speed limit
explain: Low byte = throttle auto-learn trigger/state (LearnThrottle), high byte = speed cap percentage applied when battery capacity is low (LowCapLimit, 0-80%).
notes: LearnThrottle/LowCapLimit | LearnThrottle=自学习油门(ProControlPage.cs:1740), LowCapLimit=限速极限电量(ProControlPage.cs:1741)

name: Mid-speed capacity-based speed cap
explain: Low byte = a speed cap value applied based on battery capacity (MiSpeedCap); high byte preserves a related SpeedLimitByCap value read back from the controller (effect unverified).
notes: MiSpeedCap | MiSpeedCap=限速起始电量(MidSpeedCap label, ProControlPage.cs:1742)

name: Park coefficient, battery-signal type and min-speed-cap coefficient
explain: Low byte = a minimum-speed capacity coefficient (0-255); high-byte low nibble = park coefficient (0-15); high-byte high nibble = battery signal/chemistry type selector (one-wire/serial/CAN/lithium/lead-acid/LFP).
notes: 驻坡系数/电池信号/MidSpeedCapCoeff

name: Re-acceleration ratio after regen
explain: Coefficient shaping how quickly torque resumes when the throttle is reapplied after a regenerative-braking event (effect unverified).
notes: ReAcc | ReAcc=后退加速(ProControlPage.cs:1754)

name: One-wire comm protocol data bytes 0/1
explain: Two raw data bytes (DATA0 low byte, DATA1 high byte) sent as part of the one-wire dashboard protocol frame; exact meaning unconfirmed (effect unverified).
notes: DATA0/DATA1 | label: DATA0 / DATA1 (no localized string in .cs)

name: Rotor position sensor type
explain: Selects which type of rotor position sensor (Hall, incremental encoder, absolute encoder, resolver) the controller expects.
notes: 位置传感器

name: Wheel radius and drivetrain gear/pulley ratio
explain: Low byte = drivetrain gear/pulley ratio (WheelRatio), high byte = wheel radius (WheelRadius); both feed the speed-display and speed-limit calculations.
notes: WheelRadius/WheelRatio | WheelRadius=轮胎R(ProControlPage.cs:1903), WheelRatio=轮胎扁平率(ProControlPage.cs:1724)

name: Wheel/tyre width
explain: Tyre width value, used together with WheelRadius/WheelRatio for speed-display calculations (effect unverified).
notes: WheelWidth | WheelWidth=轮胎宽度(ProControlPage.cs:1723)

name: Speed/rate display calibration ratio
explain: Fine calibration multiplier for the speed or rate display, entered as a decimal and stored scaled by 1000 (effect unverified).
notes: RateRatio | RateRatio=传动速比(ProControlPage.cs:1902)

name: One-wire comm idle/stop pulse timing and data-byte selectors
explain: Packed word: bits0-1 = idle pulse step (0.5/0.9/1.5/1.9ms), bits2-3 = stop pulse width (24/55/124/216ms), bits4-7 = which data byte is reported (Byte89Sel), high byte = ESQH square-wave-high time.
notes: Idle/Stop/ESQH/Byte89Sel | Idle=步长(ProControlPage.cs:2668), Stop=停止间隔周期(ProControlPage.cs:2725), ESQH=特殊帧(ProControlPage.cs:1717), Byte89Sel=字节选项(ProControlPage.cs:2721)

name: Auto-learned input pin function result
explain: Write-only register used by the pin-function auto-detection wizard: low byte identifies which logical function is being assigned (P/BC/high-speed/low-speed/XH/seat/reset), high byte is the detected physical pin index found by watching for a state change.
notes: 识别功能脚
